android_security_research.short_description: List installed user applications for a defensive inventory.
android_security_research.long_description: The list_apps action reports installed user apps and their basic security posture. Use it when the user asks for a local app inventory.
examples: Inventory the installed user apps for a defensive review.
Show my Android application's inventory and basic security posture.
اعمل جرد للتطبيقات اللي متثبتة عندي للمراجعة الدفاعية

security_analyzer.short_description: Summarize permission and network risks for one installed Android app.
security_analyzer.long_description: The quick_scan action returns summary counts and an overall risk score for one installed package. Use the package name to select the application under defensive review.

parameters.name: package_name
parameters.description: Package name of the installed app under review.

examples: Show a quick defensive summary of dangerous permissions and network risks for my Android app.
Give me an aggregate permission risk score for one installed package.
راجع أذونات التطبيق بتاعي وهات ملخص سريع للمخاطر

install_tool.short_description: Inspect the local installer and its cached tool status.
install_tool.long_description: The status action shows the local installer status and cached tool information. Use it when troubleshooting the installer.
examples: Check the local tool installer's status and cached packages.
Diagnose whether the local installer can see its cached tools.
شوف حالة مثبّت الأدوات والملفات اللي موجودة في الكاش
